audit.whatIsWrong: Not one of Zaahen's five abilities is named anywhere in the entry. He is described only as "he", with "his glaive chip", "his all-in" and "his ult" standing in for the whole kit.
audit.why: There is nothing for a player to react to. The Darkin Glaive is a 10-second double slash that HEALS him and can be recast for a knock-up, and it is an auto-attack reset, so the wind-up is the tell rather than the cast. Dreaded Return is an 850-range stab that PULLS you in on a 14-second cooldown — that is the actual gank setup the entry vaguely gestures at, and it is his longest cooldown. Aureate Rush is his dash. Naming them turns four abstract warnings into four countable ones.
audit.corrected: All five named with cooldowns across spikes, wants, early, mid, late and whys.
sources: champ-data/_kits/zaahen.json (Q 10/9/8/7/6 "slashes twice... healing himself... recast... knock up", autoReset; W 14/13.5/13/12.5/12, 850 range, "pulls them toward him"; E 10/9.5/9/8.5/8 dash; R 110/95/80)

audit.whatIsWrong: The entire late-game thesis is armour: "stacked armor makes his physical damage bounce", "by two items you are an unbreakable duelist he cannot out-DPS", "take every sidelane duel he is foolish enough to offer".
audit.why: Two things in his kit break that promise outright. Aureate Rush deals damage as a percentage of health, which armour does not reduce — so more health and armour is partly feeding it. And Cultivation of War lets him REVIVE once he has filled his Determination stacks, so "unbreakable duelist" describes a fight you can win and still lose. On top of both, The Darkin Glaive and Grim Deliverance are two separate heals, which means Grievous Wounds is a core purchase and the entry never mentions anti-heal once. Telling a Malphite at 49.43% to seek out side-lane duels is the most dangerous line on the page.
audit.corrected: Armour reframed as the answer to his autos only; percent-health damage, the revive and Grievous Wounds added to spikes[1], spikes[2], late, whys[5] and whys[6].
sources: champ-data/_kits/zaahen.json (E percentHealth flag; P "When filled with Determination... can revive"; Q and R both heal)

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet records zero cooldown-sequencing cues in this matchup, and reading it confirms that: not one number appears in any field, and "only commit engages on numbers you have actually counted" tells you to count without saying what.
audit.why: The numbers exist and they are lopsided in a way that dictates the whole plan. Unstoppable Force is 130 seconds at rank 1; his knock-ups are The Darkin Glaive's recast at 10 seconds and Dreaded Return at 14. You lose a displacement race thirteen times out of fourteen, so your R can never be the opener — it is only ever the answer to a commit he has already made. Grim Deliverance at 110/95/80 also returns before your ultimate at every rank. And his costs are 25 to 100 flat while Seismic Shard alone is 70 to 90 mana, so he can throw abilities to bait that you cannot.
audit.corrected: Concrete sequencing written into wants.you[2], mid, whys[4] and whys[2] — R answers his commit, never opens.
sources: champ-data/_kits/zaahen.json (Q recast knockup 10/9/8/7/6, W 14/13.5/13/12.5/12, R 110/95/80, costs 25/50/40/100)

audit.whatIsWrong: The chart's last two stages are both Malphite, and "2+ items" is captioned "Unbreakable: he cannot out-DPS your stacked armor in a duel", while the matchup sits at 49.43% over 1677 games.
audit.why: A sub-50% matchup should not end with the owner labelled unbreakable, and the two scaling mechanics in his kit both point the other way at exactly that stage: percent-health damage on Aureate Rush that ignores the armour the chart is built on, and a passive revive that comes online once he has stacked Determination through a game. The first-item armour spike is real and I left it to Malphite — his base damage profile is physical. It is the two-item stage that is wrong.
audit.corrected: Two+ items changed from Malphite to Skill; Skill / Zaahen / Skill / Skill / Skill / Malphite / Skill.

notes: Two structural things the applier should know. (1) The packet reports spikes[] has 3 entries where 4 are expected for this matchup — I did not add one, because entry counts are not mine to change, but the missing fourth spike is the reason there is no level-6 spike card here while every other Malphite matchup has one. (2) wants.foe[1] is "Gank setups off his ult" at 23 characters, which is too short to carry any real information inside a +/-10% band, so I left it — it is also the one field where I could not verify the claim, since Grim Deliverance is described only as a rise-and-stab with a heal and nothing in the kit says it sets up a gank. QUESTION recorded for the user. Separately, Zaahen's enemyAbilities came back null in the packet even though champ-data/_kits/zaahen.json exists and is complete — worth checking the packet builder, since any agent working from the packet alone would have had no ability names for this champion at all.
